articles.title: When Catherine Zeta-Jones Told Michael Douglas She Wanted to Be Monogamous, He Had to Break It Off with 5 Other Women
articles.summary: The actor recalls the moment his future wife gave him an ultimatum early in their relationship
articles.body:
Michael Douglas says Catherine Zeta-Jones gave him an ultimatum early in their relationship

He was newly separated from Diandra Douglas and dating five women in different cities

Douglas and Zeta-Jones married in 1999 and share two children together

Michael Douglas had a few calls to make when Catherine Zeta-Jones made it clear she wasn't interested in sharing him.

In his new memoir, One Helluva Ride , Douglas, 82, looks back on the early days of his relationship with Zeta-Jones, 57, and reveals that the actress wasn't interested in becoming another relationship in his rotation. If he wanted to be with her, she made it clear, he had to be with her exclusively.

"She told me she understood that I was a single guy who'd come out of a long marriage, but she would only be monogamous," Douglas writes. "'I'm not interested in dating you if you're dating other people. You can either continue with them or end it and be with me.'"

Douglas had a pretty simple response, though he needed a minute — or, more specifically, five phone calls.

"I told her wait here I have to make five quick calls. 'Five? You have to make five calls?'" he recalls.

At the time, Douglas was still newly separated from his first wife, Diandra Douglas , whom he split from in 1995. He had been seeing five other women, though he says he viewed the arrangement as relatively straightforward.

"Just after my marriage, I had been seeing five other women. They knew I was recently separated and in the process of getting a divorce," he writes. "I made sure they all lived in different cities, which felt like a respectful way to be non-monogamous."

Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories.

According to Douglas, none of the women had asked him for something more serious or even questioned whether he was seeing anyone else.

"None of them asked for a commitment or even asked what else I was up to. I am sure they were seeing other people, too," he writes.

But once Zeta-Jones made her position clear, Douglas knew what he wanted to do.

"That day, I called each one to say I met somebody and would no longer be able to continue seeing them. They all took it well," he writes.

And just like that, five relationships were over and Douglas was all in on Zeta-Jones.

One Helluva Ride doesn't shy away from the romantic chapters that came before Douglas' life with Zeta-Jones. He writes candidly about his past affairs, including romantic entanglements with his Romancing the Stone costar Kathleen Turner and Basic Instinct costar Jeanne Tripplehorn .

By the time he met Zeta-Jones, however, Douglas was already completely smitten. He first saw her in an early screening of her 1998 film The Mask of Zorro , then happened to cross paths with her a few weeks later at the Deauville American Film Festival in France while he was promoting A Perfect Murder .

He asked his publicist to arrange a meeting over drinks, and he quickly found himself impressed by more than her beauty.

"She was smart, funny, unpretentious, and, yes, breathtakingly beautiful. She just seemed so confident and self-assured, too," Douglas recalls in the book.

Later, after a dinner with Zeta-Jones and her Zorro costar Antonio Banderas and his then-wife Melanie Griffith , Douglas was even more taken with her. There was just one problem: He admits he was "smashed" by the end of the night.

As he walked Zeta-Jones to the hotel elevator to say good night, Douglas blurted out what would become one of his most memorable lines: "I'm going to be the father of your children."

"It wasn't a cheap pickup line. It was the truth," he writes.

The pair went on to marry in 1999 and have two children, Dylan, 26, and Carys, 23 . Douglas also shares son Cameron , 47, with Diandra, 70.

Nearly 26 years later, Douglas' relationship with Zeta-Jones has only grown deeper.

"There's just an unknown at a certain point over time," he tells PEOPLE. "It goes beyond being attracted to somebody in this matter. It's just an unknown bond of being close and… a mutual respect."

One Helluva Ride by Michael Douglas is available now, wherever books are sold.

articles.title: Shia LaBeouf’s wife Mia Goth files for divorce amid his legal turmoil
articles.summary: The two actors were married in 2016
articles.body:
Mia Goth has filed for divorce from Shia LaBeouf after 10 years of marriage, citing irreconcilable differences, and is seeking primary custody of their daughter Isabel.

The divorce filing comes after LaBeouf's ex-girlfriend, FKA twigs, settled a lawsuit against him, allowing her to speak freely about her alleged experiences of sexual abuse during their relationship.

LaBeouf is currently on probation after pleading guilty to misdemeanor battery charges following a drunken brawl in New Orleans, and has expressed regret for his past mistakes in his relationship with Goth.

Mia Goth has filed for divorce from Shia LaBeouf after 10 years of marriage.

The Pearl star, 32, filed the papers Tuesday night and cited "irreconcilable differences" as the reason, according to TMZ .

Although they have been legally married since October 2016, the former couple had a turbulent on-and-off relationship in the public eye for over a decade. After Goth and LaBeouf met on the set of Nymphomaniac: Vol. II in 2012, they tied the knot in Las Vegas in 2016 and broke up two years later. They then reconciled around 2020 and welcomed their daughter, Isabel, in 2022. Their date of separation is listed on the documents as July 28, 2025.

Goth is asking for primary legal and physical custody of Isabel, and is requesting to terminate the court's ability to award spousal support to either of the actors.

The Independent has reached out to representatives for Goth and LaBeouf for comment.

News of the filing comes just one day after LaBeouf's ex-girlfriend, singer FKA twigs, settled a lawsuit against the 40-year-old Megalopolis actor , meaning she is now free to speak about her alleged experiences of sexual abuse with him.

The lawsuit was settled after LaBeouf agreed to end the nondisclosure provisions from the former couple's settlement in December 2025.

Their long legal fight started in 2020, when Twigs accused LaBeouf of being sexually, mentally and physically abusive throughout their relationship, which lasted for about nine months in 2018. LaBeouf denied the allegations at the time.

The singer's attorney, Mathew Rosengart, said Wednesday in a statement shared with The Independent : "On the heels of Mr. LaBeouf's now dismissed, failed December 2025 arbitration against Twigs in which he sought money from her, this important victory completely frees her to discuss her experience, advocate for other women who might be less privileged, and freely support the charitable causes of her choice, which she was previously blocked from doing. To her great credit, Twigs stood up for something larger than herself, all female survivors of sexual abuse."

LaBeouf's attorney, Shawn Holley, said that the former Disney Channel star "wishes Twigs nothing but the best in her life and career and, to that end, has agreed to end their long-standing dispute."

"Twigs has spoken about this matter for years and there is now nothing to prevent her from continuing to do so," Holley told The Independent . She refused to comment on Goth's filing.

LaBeouf is currently on probation after he was arrested after getting into a drunken brawl in New Orleans in February. He pleaded guilty to misdemeanor battery charges in June and was sentenced to two years' probation, rehabilitation for alcohol abuse, sensitivity training and anger management classes.

The actor had moved to the Louisiana city after his separation from Goth, Page Six reported at the time.

In March, he spoke about his breakup with Goth in an interview on Channel 5 With Andrew Callaghan.

"We were deeply unhappy," LaBeouf said. "I made a lot of mistakes early on before we tried to have a baby. I had violated trust in a big, big way."

He said that their problems were "impossible" to fix, but that he still had love and respect for Goth. "We're in a good spot. I mean, this isn't new," he said. "We've been there for a while, we're trying to figure out co-parenting, and we're good. Even through all this, she gives me grace."

The national domestic abuse helpline offers support for women on 0808 2000 247, or you can visit the Refuge website. There is a dedicated men's advice line on 0808 8010 327. articles.title: Before Hollywood and global fame, Jennifer Lopez once slept at dance studio while pursuing her career: ‘I was homeless before I got famous'
articles.summary: Discover Jennifer Lopez's inspiring story of overcoming homelessness at 18 while pursuing her dreams in dance and acting, ultimately leading her to become a global superstar with a net worth of $400 million. Learn about her early struggles, family dynamics, and breakthrough roles in her rise to fame.
articles.body: Jennifer Lopez’s early career transition from the Bronx to Hollywood involved a period of sacrifice that she later described as being technically homeless. The singer and actress came from a middle-class background and worked her way up in the industry step by step; however, there was a brief time period when she had to stay in a dance studio to make ends meet.Jennifer Lopez once stayed in a dance studioDuring one of her old interviews with W Magazine, the singer opened up about how she faced homelessness at one point in her life when she was 18 years old. She shared, "I was homeless before I got famous. I was homeless.” She added that she and her mother fought about her future a lot and that her mother did not really support her decision to pursue the entertainment industry. While Lopez wanted to dance, her mother wanted her to go to college and get an education. The two fought too much to the point where Lopez revealed during the interview that she had to move out of her home. "My mom and I butted heads. I didn't want to go to college—I wanted to try dance full-time. So she and I had a break," she shared. Lopez added, “I told her, ‘This is what I have to do.'"Unable to stay at her parents' house and lacking the funds to rent a place in New York City, Lopez often slept on the sofa in her Manhattan dance studio. During the day, she would take intensive dance classes and go to auditions and later would return to sleep on the studio couch after hours.Jennifer Lopez’s big breakHer IG break came within the same year and helped her rise to the top. She first landed a job dancing in Europe in a production of Golden Musicals of Broadway and later toured Japan too. When she returned home, she booked ‘In Living Color’ and became one of the Fly Girls. However, this resulted in her leaving NYC for Los Angeles.Jennifer Lopez credits her parents for her successDespite the differences between her and her mother, Lopez still credited her parents as the reason why she worked so hard and actually made it in the industry. During the interview she opened up about how hard her parents used to work to make ends meet and to make sure that she had a good life growing up, which is what she applied to her work.Jennifer Lopez’s net worthAccording to Celebrity Net Worth, the singer and actress has an overall net worth of USD 400 million. From the Bronx to becoming one of the top stars in the Hollywood industry, Lopez has surely come a long way. After ‘In Living Color,' the star rose to fame after starring as Tejano singer Selena Quintanilla in 'Selena,' which earned her widespread acclaim and established her as a leading actress. She also appeared in ‘Out of Sight,' ‘The Wedding Planner,' and ‘Maid in Manhattan,' to name a few.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Zendaya’s rise to fame: How ‘Euphoria’ and ‘Spider-Man’ cemented the star as a rising force in the Hollywood industry
articles.summary: Explore Zendaya's incredible journey from her early beginnings in theater to her rise as a Hollywood A-lister, marked by iconic roles in 'Euphoria' and 'Spider-Man', and her relationship with Tom Holland.
articles.body: Zendaya, born Zendaya Maree Stoermer Coleman on September 1, 1996, has become one of the most successful stars in the Hollywood industry presently. From child star to Hollywood A-lister, she turned her life around and has now worked with the likes of Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Hugh Jackman, Javier Bardem, Rebecca Ferguson, Josh Brolin, and many others. Here is a look at her start in the industry along with her rise to one of the biggest stars in the Hollywood industry.Zendaya’s early lifeZendaya’s upbringing was heavily rooted in theater and acting, all thanks to her mother. While growing up in Oakland, California, her mother used to work as the house manager at the California Shakespeare Theater in Orinda. This is where the actress spent most of her childhood helping out, studying acting, and training in hip-hop dance groups and local theater productions, which all helped hone her skills in the arts.As for her education, she attended the Oakland School for the Arts and spent her time performing in Shakespearean plays like ‘Twelfth Night’ and ‘Richard III.' She also started working as a child model and commercial actor at the time, before she and her family moved to Los Angeles to give her career in showbiz a better chance.Zendaya’s breakthrough as child actressShe scored her breakthrough roles around 2013, landing her role as Rocky Blue alongside Bella Thorne on the teen show ‘Shake It Up.' This helped her solidify her footing in the industry and helped her also explore music as a profession. She also released her self-titled debut pop album in 2013, featuring the hit single ‘Replay.’Her next big project came with ‘Dancing with the Stars,’ where she finished as the runner-up at age 16. She was the youngest contestant at the time. She later returned to acting to star in and produce ‘K.C. Undercover,' one of her first roles as a producer.Zendaya’s film debut with ‘Spider-Man’In 2018, she finally scored her leading role in the film ‘Spider-Man: Homecoming’ opposite Tom Holland. The film was a massive success and launched the star right into global stardom. Around the same time, she also starred with Zac Efron in the hit musical ‘The Greatest Showman’ and went viral after it was reported that she did many of her own trapeze stunts in the film.Her role as Rue Bennett in ‘Euphoria’ made history in 2020 as she became the youngest recipient to win the Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series. She won the award yet again in 2022. Following this, she starred in a lot of blockbuster hits, including the ‘Dune’ franchise, 'Challengers,' ‘Malcolm & Marie,' the ‘Spider-Man’ franchise, and ‘The Drama.'Zendaya and Tom Holland’s relationship timelineHolland and Zendaya met for the first time during the filming of the first ‘Spider-Man’ film, and right from the beginning they became close friends. Right from the start, rumors of the two being in a relationship started circulating; however, for the next couple of years, the two maintained that they were nothing more than good friends. In 2021, however, paparazzi photographed the co-stars sharing a kiss in a car in Los Angeles. Later that year, Holland publicly acknowledged their relationship in a GQ interview, sharing that they felt "robbed of their privacy." Since then, the two have maintained that their relationship is their private business and that they do not wish to share any aspect of it with the public.Around 2024, after attending events together on multiple occasions, Holland proposed to the ‘Shake It Up’ singer in an intimate, low-key setting over the 2024 holiday season. Zendaya made the engagement public when she debuted her diamond ring at the 2025 Golden Globes, sending fans of the couple into a frenzy. Since earlier this year, there have been rumors of the two getting married in a private ceremony, which were started by Law Roach, Zendaya’s designer, who had earlier shared that the two had already gotten married.Since then, Zendaya has not shared any statements about the topic. Holland has called her his wife during an interview while promoting ‘The Odyssey.'Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: David Bustamante vende un perfume cada 15 segundos: "No son mi mayor fuente de ingresos, pero podría vivir de ellos sin problema"
articles.summary: El cantante David Bustamante ha visitado este miércoles 'El Hormiguero' para presentar 'El Zorro', el musical que va a protagonizar en el madrileño teatro La Latina a partir del 25 de noviembre.
articles.body: El cantante David Bustamante ha visitado este miércoles 'El Hormiguero' para presentar 'El Zorro', el musical que va a protagonizar en el madrileño teatro La Latina a partir del 25 de noviembre. PABLO MOTOS. Estrenas 'El Zorro', ¿qué es lo que más miedo te da que falle en la primera función? DAVID BUSTAMANTE. Que no me acuerde del texto. Tengo pesadillas con eso. El resto ya es jugar, y encima me dan espadas, ¿qué más puedo pedir? Es durísimo el teatro musical, me parecen unos artistas compuestísimos los actores de teatro musical. PABLO MOTOS. Dices que tienes muchos dolores. DAVID BUSTAMANTE. Sí, me duele todo. Hoy he estado ensayando caídas y cuando te caes cincuenta veces, acabas bastante dolorido. Yo, además, tengo vértigo y hay una escena en la que El Zorro vuela, con un arnés, por encima del público, pero tengo tantas cosas en las que pensar, que no creo que me acuerde del vértigo. Ya me pasaba cuando era albañil y hacía tejados, que tenía que traer el jornal a casa y no podía pensar en el vértigo. PABLO MOTOS. Habrá niños y niñas, chicos y chicas, que vayan a verte al teatro y no sepan quién es Bustamante y vean solo a 'El Zorro'. DAVID BUSTAMANTE. Ya me empieza a pasar, como llevo tantos años, llegan nuevas generaciones que no tienen ni idea de quién soy. Luego hay chicos de otras generaciones que veo en los conciertos y que se saben todos los temas, no sé si me conocen por la velada o por qué, pero me escuchan y se quedan. PABLO MOTOS. Tienes catorce perfumes en el mercado, ¿si voy a tu casa me los encontraría todos? DAVID BUSTAMANTE. Sí claro, están en el baño. Me estoy haciendo una casa y he hecho una hornacina con luz led para poner mis perfumes. Hay quien pone los Grammy y yo, como no los tengo, pongo mis perfumes. Se vende uno cada quince segundos, eso es porque la gente sabe que hago buenas fragancias. Mis favoritos son el primero, 'Muy mío', y este último. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Podrías vivir solo de la venta de los perfumes? DAVID BUSTAMANTE. Sí, perfectamente. No es que sean mi mayor fuente de ingresos, pero podría vivir de ellos sin problema. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Qué tal el entrenamiento con la espada? DAVID BUSTAMANTE. Estoy todavía en ello, aprendiendo. Yo me he cortado a mí mismo en las rodillas, porque todavía no controlo y me creo que sí. PABLO MOTOS. Estás también de gira. ¿Qué te pasó en un concierto de la gira con una mantis? DAVID BUSTAMANTE. Sí, me quedan cuatro conciertos. En un concierto estaba cantando una canción de amor y una mantis religiosa que pasaba por allí se lo tomó muy en serio y se me quedó enganchada en la cremallera del pantalón.

articles.title: Festival de Cinema Italiano chega à 21ª edição com 24 filmes gratuitos; veja destaques da programação | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento mais de 120 salas em 90 cidades brasileiras e segue até 1º de dezembro.
articles.summary: Evento mais de 120 salas em 90 cidades brasileiras e segue até 1º de dezembro.
articles.body:
Festival de Cinema Italiano no Brasil — Foto: Reprodução

Quem gosta de cinema italiano já pode colocar a data na agenda: a 21ª edição do Festival de Cinema Italiano no Brasil começa em 5 de novembro e reúne 24 filmes, entre produções inéditas e clássicos. A programação ocupa mais de 120 salas em 90 cidades brasileiras e segue até 1º de dezembro, com entrada gratuita.

Entre os destaques está Scherzetto (Travessura), novo filme do diretor Mario Martone, com Toni Servillo e o jovem Lorenzo Perrotta. Baseado na obra de Domenico Starnone, o longa acompanha o encontro entre um avô acostumado à solidão e seu neto pequeno, em uma convivência que coloca duas gerações em confronto.

Ao todo, são 14 filmes inéditos — alguns recém-exibidos no Festival de Veneza — e dez clássicos. A retrospectiva desta edição, batizada de "Itália em Cena", reúne obras em que cidades, ilhas e paisagens costeiras italianas têm papel importante nas histórias. E quem preferir o sofá também poderá assistir a parte da seleção por streaming, gratuitamente, de qualquer lugar do Brasil.

📅 Quando? De 5 de novembro a 1º de dezembro

📍 Onde? Mais de 120 salas de cinema em 90 cidades brasileiras

articles.title: Juliana Linhares faz em janeiro, no Rio, a gravação audiovisual do show 'Até cansar o cansaço', destaque de 2026  | G1
articles.body:
Juliana Linhares na estreia do show 'Até cansar o cansaço', em julho, no Rio de Janeiro (RJ) — Foto: Rodrigo Goffredo

♬ Um dos melhores shows de 2026 – e dos últimos anos – vai ser eternizado em 2027. Juliana Linhares fará a gravação audiovisual do show “Até cansar o cansaço” em 19 de janeiro, no Circo Voador (RJ), na volta da turnê ao Rio de Janeiro (RJ), cidade onde o espetáculo estreou em 16 de julho, entronizando a cantora potiguar como uma das maiores artistas do Brasil na atualidade pela força do canto teatral da intérprete e pela alta qualidade do repertório autoral da ascendente compositora.

O registro audiovisual do show “Até cansar o cansaço” será feito pela artista com convidados ainda não revelados, todos sob a direção musical do multi-instrumentista Elísio Freitas, arranjador do show e guitarrista da banda formada por Julia Rodrigues (bateria), Lucas Videla (percussão), Paloma Ronai (sanfona) e Nathanne Rodrigues (baixo).

Derivado do segundo álbum solo da cantora e compositora, também intitulado “Até cansar o cansaço” (2026) e lançado em 8 de maio, o show abarca no roteiro músicas como “Tesoura do desejo” (Alceu Valença, 1991) e “Chama da criança” (Juliana Linhares e Demarca, 2024), música do último álbum da banda Pietá, na qual a cantora foi revelada.

No show “Até cansar o cansaço” , assim como no álbum homônimo, Juliana Linhares dá voz a repertório que capta o estado de ansiedade e exaustão da humanidade no suor da lira incessante da era digital.

articles.title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' box office collection day 6: Ajay Devgn and Tabu's film earns Rs 15.50 cr and records a 20.5% drop; India net reaches Rs 232.50 cr
articles.summary: Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' continued its theatrical run with a strong overall hold on Wednesday.
articles.body: Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' continued its theatrical run with a strong overall hold on Wednesday. The mystery thriller witnessed a 20.5% decline from its previous day's earnings. However, it remained above the Rs 15 cr mark on its sixth day. 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' has recorded a worldwide gross of Rs 366.50 cr. The film's six-day theatrical performance brought its total footfalls to 9,504,076.'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' earns Rs 15.50 cr on Day 6According to Sacnilk, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' collected Rs 15.50 cr net in India on October 7. The sixth-day earnings came from 15,972 shows. The film's India net collection has now climbed to Rs 232.50 cr. Its India gross collection has reached Rs 279.00 cr. The latest figure comes after the film delivered Rs 19.50 cr on its fifth day.'Drishyam 3' worldwide collection reaches Rs 366.50 crThe Ajay Devgn starrer also continued to contribute to its overseas total. The film added Rs 6.00 cr from international markets on Day 6. Its cumulative overseas gross collection has consequently reached Rs 87.50 cr. The movie recorded 721,016 footfalls on its sixth day alone.Day-wise box office performance of 'Drishyam 3''Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' opened with Rs 62.00 cr on October 2, which was its first Friday. It registered 60.1% occupancy across 15,759 shows. The movie collected Rs 53.50 cr on its first Saturday. It played across 16,868 shows and recorded 48.1% occupancy. On Sunday, the film bounced back with Rs 61.00 cr from 17,323 shows. Its occupancy stood at 56.0%.The first Monday brought the expected decline in weekday collections. The film earned Rs 21.00 cr from 16,274 shows, with occupancy at 25.0%. On Tuesday, it collected Rs 19.50 cr across 16,075 shows. Occupancy stood at 24.0%. On Wednesday, the collection settled at Rs 15.50 cr from 15,972 shows. The overall occupancy for Day 6 was 19.0%.'Drishyam 3' Day 6 occupancy The Hindi 2D version of 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' recorded 18.98% overall occupancy on Day 6. Morning shows registered 10.31%, while afternoon screenings recorded 16.00%. Evening occupancy stood at 20.92%, followed by 28.69% for night shows.What is the plot of 'Drishyam 3'?The story takes place years after Vijay Salgaonkar managed to stay ahead of the law. Meera Deshmukh returns with revenge in mind rather than simply pursuing justice. Meanwhile, a new Crime Branch officer begins examining Vijay's carefully constructed defense. Jaideep Ahlawat plays Rajveer Tomar, the police officer determined to accomplish what his predecessors could not. He believes he has fresh evidence that could finally break through Vijay's alibis and expose him. Rajveer's approach is summed up by his statement, “System ka darr bana rehna chahiye.”Ajay Devgn's Vijay faces another challengeVijay Salgaonkar, played by Ajay Devgn, has already survived similar confrontations. His experience gives him confidence as he faces another attempt to bring him down. His response is captured in the line, “Agar hero jail mein gaya, toh audience ko accha lagega?”'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' is written by Aamil Keeyan Khan, Abhishek Pathak and Parveez Shaikh. ETimes awarded the film 3.5 stars out of 5.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collections day 62: Vishal Chaturvedi's film collects Rs 80 lakhs; ninth-week run continues; India net at Rs 327.28 cr
articles.summary: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' continues to hold up at the domestic box office in its ninth week.
articles.body: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' continues to hold up at the domestic box office in its ninth week. The devotional film, featuring Shobhinaw Satyaa as spiritual guru Neem Karoli Baba, has stayed in theatres despite the arrival of newer releases.According to Sacnilk, 'Hanuman Ansh' collected Rs 80 lakhs net in India on Day 62, October 7. The film recorded the day's earnings across 1,578 shows. Its total India net collection has now reached Rs 327.28 cr, while the India gross stands at Rs 386.56 cr. The movie also added Rs 5 lakhs from overseas markets on its 62nd day. Its cumulative overseas gross collection has reached Rs 39.95 cr. Consequently, the worldwide gross of 'Hanuman Ansh' has climbed to Rs 426.51 cr. The Day 62 collection was 20.0% lower than the Rs 1.00 cr net earned on the previous day.'Hanuman Ansh' sees varied performance across nine weeksThe film's weekly earnings have fluctuated significantly since its theatrical release. 'Hanuman Ansh' collected Rs 1.08 cr during its first week. Its second-week collection stood at Rs 40 lakhs. The movie witnessed a substantial increase in its third week. It earned Rs 10.40 cr during that period. The fourth week brought in Rs 61.00 cr. The film continued its strong run in the fifth week, collecting Rs 90.25 cr. Its sixth-week earnings amounted to Rs 80.25 cr. The movie added Rs 44.80 cr in its seventh week and another Rs 29.20 cr in its eighth week.Ninth-week box office figures'Hanuman Ansh' opened its ninth week with Rs 2.25 cr on Day 57, October 2. The film registered 54.0% occupancy across 1,166 shows. On Day 58, October 3, it collected Rs 2.10 cr from 1,339 shows. The occupancy for the day stood at 39.0%. The movie recorded its biggest ninth-week daily collection on Day 59, October 4. It earned Rs 3.00 cr from 1,399 shows, with occupancy reaching 57.0%. The collection dropped to Rs 75 lakhs on Day 60, October 5. The film had 1,475 shows and registered 19.0% occupancy. It then recovered to Rs 1.00 cr on Day 61, October 6. The figure came from 1,570 shows, which recorded 32.0% occupancy. Day 62 brought Rs 80 lakhs from 1,578 shows. The film recorded 17.0% occupancy on Wednesday. It also registered 51,265 footfalls during the day.'Hanuman Ansh' Day 62 occupancyThe ninth-week performance of 'Hanuman Ansh' continued with an overall occupancy of 17.0% on Day 62. The film's morning shows recorded 16.20% occupancy. Afternoon screenings registered 17.00%, while evening shows recorded 20.20%. Night shows had 17.00% occupancy.Kainchi Dham draws attention after film's successKainchi Dham, an ashram and Hanuman temple in Uttarakhand associated with Neem Karoli Baba, reportedly witnessed a major influx of devotees over the weekend. Claims about the surge were circulated through viral social media videos. The spiritual site has gained additional attention following the theatrical performance of 'Hanuman Ansh'. Vishal Chaturvedi addressed the situation through an Instagram video. The director asked people planning to travel to Kainchi Dham to exercise discretion before visiting the site. He also urged visitors to keep the safety of women and children in mind. Vishal Chaturvedi further suggested that people could explore other locations associated with Neem Karoli Baba if necessary.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: Nana Patekar passes away at 75: Actor's last rites to be held at his Pune farmhouse
articles.summary: Bollywood mourns the loss of veteran actor Nana Patekar, renowned for his powerful performances and contributions to Indian cinema, as he passes away at the age of 75.
articles.body: Veteran actor Nana Patekar has passed away at the age of 75 after suffering a severe cardiac arrest. The National Award-winning actor was among the most respected and distinctive performers in Hindi and Marathi cinema.Nana Patekar was found unconscious at his Goa homeThe actor was found unconscious at his residence in Dona Paula, Goa. He was subsequently rushed to a hospital, but the doctors declared him dead. According to ANI, Dr. Shekhar Salkar, Chief of the Oncology Department, Manipal Hospital, has shared that despite 45 minutes of continuous CPR, the actor could not be revived. Further, a medico-legal case (MLC) has been registered, and a post-mortem is being conducted.GMC Dean JP Tiwari has constituted a team of three doctors for the autopsy. This panel includes Dr Kedar Narvekar, Associate Professor, Department of Medicine, Dr Pannag S Kumar, Assistant Professor, Department of Forensic Medicine and Dr Peter Rodrigues, Lecturer, Department of Pathology.Nana Patekar's last rites to be held at his Pune farmhouseAccording to PTI, the last rites of Nana Patekar will be performed at his farmhouse, located at Donje on the outskirts of Pune, Maharashtra, on Thursday."The mortal remains will be brought (to Pune) by around 5 pm, and later will be kept for the last 'darshan'. The last rites will be performed on the premises of his farmhouse," said Ganesh Thorat, the CEO of the actor's Naam Foundation.Further, Maharashtra Culture Minister Ashish Shelar has shared that Nana Patekar will be accorded a state funeral. The decision has been taken by the Devendra Fadnavis government, considering the late legendary's artist's unparalleled contribution to Marathi theatre and Marathi as well as Hindi cinema.Film industry pays tribute to Nana PatekarThe news has shattered the industry, with the film fraternity members and fans trying to process the loss. After the news of Nana Patekar's demise came out, Marathi actor Siddharth Jadhav expressed his grief. While speaking to ETimes, he said he is " in shock after knowing about the death; this was not the time to go. He had many things to do yet. In deep shock, couldn't process the news."Meanwhile, several actors have taken to their social media handles to express their profound grief. “I was deeply saddened to hear the extremely tragic news of Nana Patekar Ji’s passing early this morning. Despite being a star, Nana Ji was always far removed from the trappings of stardom,” shared Ravi Kishan on his social media story.He recalled the late actor as “one of the great artists of Indian cinema, known for his simplicity, humility and his down-to-earth personality.”“Even while living amidst the glitz and glamour of Mumbai, he never lost touch with his roots and values. I shared a close and warm relationship with Nana Ji. We would speak from time to time, and I learned a great deal from his acting, simplicity and perspective on life,” wrote the actor-politician.About Nana PatekarBorn as Vishwanath Patekar in 1951 in Maharashtra, Nana Patekar’s journey into the world of acting started in the late 1970s. 'Gaman' was his debut film; following it, he gave one performance after another to establish himself in the industry.Some of his most loved cinematic pieces include 'Parinda', 'Prahaar', 'Angaar', 'Krantiveer', 'Agni Sakshi', 'Yashwant', 'Ab Tak Chhappan', 'Apaharan', 'Welcome' and 'Natsamrat', among several others. His performances frequently moved beyond conventional hero and villain roles.The late legendary star was honoured with the National Award thrice. In 1989, he received the National Award for Best Supporting Actor for 'Parinda' and got the Best Actor title for 'Krantiveer in 1994. Then in 1996, he was again honoured with the National Award for Best Supporting Actor in 'Agni Sakshi.' Further, he was honoured with the Padma Shri for his contribution to the arts in 2013.Nana Patekar built a career spanning several decades across films, theatre and television. With powerful screen presence, intense dialogue delivery and the ability to portray complex characters with remarkable restraint, the actor made a unique place for himself in Indian cinema.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Nana Patekar dies at 75: 'Who knows about tomorrow,' actor's words at last public appearance 4 days before death
articles.body: PANAJI: "I am here today. Who knows about tomorrow." Just four days before his death, veteran actor Nana Patekar spoke about the uncertainty of life while attending an event in Goa, urging people to serve others and make the most of their time.Patekar, 75, was the chief guest at the October 4 installation ceremony of Rajshri Khandeparkar of Samrat International Club in Goa, former MP Narendra Sawaikar said.Merely four days ago, Nana Patekar said, "This is how life should be lived. Serve as much as you can. After all, what are we going to take with us when we leave," according to Sawaikar.Sawaikar said Patekar "spoke fearlessly and frankly" at the event, where he "took jibes and also gave some from his own pocket." He also danced with the Samai dance group, Sawaikar said.Patekar died on Thursday after suffering a severe cardiac arrest. He was found unconscious at his apartment and rushed to a private medical facility in the early hours of Thursday, according to Dr Shekhar Salkar, chief of the Department of Oncology at Manipal Hospital.Patekar was declared dead at 5.20am.Also read: Nana Patekar dies at 75: His life in pictures"He was brought dead to the hospital at 4.20am and despite giving CPR he could not be revived following which he was declared dead. The body has been sent for post-mortem to the Goa Medical College." Salkar said.Tributes poured in from across the country following the death of the National Award-winning actor, who was known for his work in theatre, Hindi and Marathi cinema.Goa chief minister Pramod Sawant said he was "Shocked and deeply saddened to learn about the demise of the veteran actor.""With his remarkable journey across theatre, Hindi and Marathi cinema, his powerful performances and distinctive artistry left an indelible mark on Indian cinema. My heartfelt condolences to his family, friends, admirers and the entire film fraternity." he said.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Goa | Silver Rate in Goa | Bank Holidays in Goa | Public Holidays in Goa | Petrol Price in GoaStay updated with the latest Goa news. articles.title: Atul Agnihotri remembers Nana Patekar: ‘His intensity, honesty, and complete commitment to his craft were extraordinary' - Exclusive
articles.summary: Nana Patekar’s sudden demise has left the film industry in deep shock and sorrow.
articles.body: Nana Patekar’s sudden demise has left the film industry in deep shock and sorrow. The veteran actor, who was 75, passed away on Thursday morning, October 8, after suffering a cardiac arrest at his residence in Dona Paula, Goa. He was found unconscious and was rushed to a hospital, where doctors attempted to revive him for around 45 minutes. However, he could not be saved and was declared dead at around 5:20 am.Known for his intense performances and powerful screen presence, Nana Patekar leaves behind a rich body of work spanning Hindi and Marathi cinema. Among his most celebrated performances was his titular role in 'Krantiveer,' which earned him the National Film Award for Best Actor. His work in films such as 'Parinda,' 'Agni Sakshi,' 'Ab Tak Chhappan,' 'Natsamrat,' and 'Welcome' further established his versatility as an actor.For many, 'Krantiveer' remains one of Nana Patekar’s most iconic films, with his powerful performance and memorable moments continuing to resonate with audiences. His work in the film also takes fans back to the popular song 'Love Rap,' which featured Nana alongside the cast.ETimes contacted actor-producer Atul Agnihotri, who had the opportunity to work with Nana Patekar in 'Krantiveer' and 'Yeshwant.' Recalling his association with the late actor, Atul said, "I am deeply saddened and shocked by the sudden passing of Nana ji.I had the privilege of working with him in 'Krantiveer' and 'Yeshwant,' and those memories will always hold a very special place in my heart. Working with Nana ji was an experience in itself. His intensity, honesty, and complete commitment to his craft were extraordinary. He had an aura and presence that were impossible to ignore, both on screen and off it."Atul also expressed his condolences to Nana Patekar’s family. He said, "My deepest condolences to Malhar and the entire Patekar family. May God give them strength during this difficult time."Nana Patekar’s death has prompted an outpouring of grief from the film fraternity and fans across the country. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also mourned the veteran actor’s demise, describing his contribution to Hindi and Marathi cinema as immense and saying that his passing has left a deep void.The Maharashtra government has announced that Nana Patekar will be accorded a funeral with full state honors, recognizing his immense contribution to Indian cinema.See More: Nana Patekar passes away: PM Modi hails veteran star's contribution to Hindi and Marathi cinemaGet the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'He has suddenly left us': Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis mourns Nana Patekar's demise
articles.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday condoled the death of veteran actor Nana Patekar, saying that Indian cinema had lost a towering
articles.body: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday condoled the death of veteran actor Nana Patekar, saying that Indian cinema had lost a towering face of acting and sensitivity.In a condolence message, Fadnavis said Patekar had made an unparalleled contribution to Marathi and Hindi cinema and given both the industries a distinct era through his powerful performances.The 76-year-old actor, known for his versatility and powerful screen presence, passed away at his Goa residence in the early hours of Thursday,"Indian cinema received, in Nana, a rugged yet equally sensitive actor from the soil of Maharashtra. He was as large-hearted as he was a towering presence on screen," Fadnavis said, describing his sudden demise as shocking.The chief minister said Patekar's portrayal of characters, from "Krantiveer" to "Natsamrat", reflected the depth and range of his acting, adding that his death was a major loss to the film world.Fadnavis also recalled Patekar's social work through Naam Foundation, which he had established along with actor Makarand Anaspure. The foundation worked for farmers and extended assistance during droughts, he said."Nana always remained at the forefront when it came to helping farmers and extending a helping hand during droughts. Even this year, as we face drought, he would not have stayed away, but he has suddenly left us," Fadnavis said.The chief minister said Patekar's forthright and fearless personality left a lasting impression wherever he went. He also recalled the actor's support for the Jalyukt Shivar campaign.Fadnavis expressed solidarity with the Patekar family and fans and paid his heartfelt tributes to the veteran actor.See More: Nana Patekar passes away: PM Modi hails veteran star's contribution to Hindi and Marathi cinemaGet the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Meet Nana Patekar’s wife Neelakanti Patekar, the award-winning actor who gave up IIT for the arts
articles.summary: Nana Patekar, a towering presence in Hindi and Marathi cinema, breathed his last at the age of 75.
articles.body: Nana Patekar, a towering presence in Hindi and Marathi cinema, breathed his last at the age of 75. The actor suffered a cardiac arrest at his Goa home and passed away at 5:20 am on Thursday, as confirmed by Dr Shekhar Salkar, head of Oncology at Manipal Hospital, in a statement to ANI. His wife, Neelakanti, who has had her own career in Marathi theatre and films, and their son, Malhar, survive him.How Neelakanti Patekar and Nana Patekar's love story beganThe love story of Nana Patekar and Neelakanti began on the Marathi stage. Neelakanti, then a bank officer who pursued acting alongside her job, became a friend before she became his partner. They married in 1978. Their early married life was marked by joy as well as grief, as they lost their first child at the age of two and a half.Neelakanti Patekar's unconventional path to actingNeelakanti took an unusual road to acting. She was born in Pune, but her father's postings in the Central Excise Department meant she spent her childhood in several different cities. She went on to study Physics, and when her father pushed her to try the IIT entrance exam, she passed it. But theatre was what she really wanted, so she chose the stage over an engineering career.Neelakanti Patekar's award-winning career in theatre and cinemaDespite her background in Physics, Neelakanti's heart was in acting. She became deeply involved in Marathi theatre and earned a name for herself as a performer, winning the Gold Medal for Best Actress at the Maharashtra State Drama Competition in 1973. She later moved into Marathi cinema, and in 1989 she starred opposite Sachin Pilgaonkar in Aatm Vishwas, a film he also directed. Her performance in the lead role earned her the Maharashtra State Government's Best Actress award.Neelakanti Patekar's comeback with ‘Chhaava’Neelakanti returned to acting after a long break from the limelight. She appeared in the historical drama ‘Chhaava’, starring Vicky Kaushal and Rashmika Mandanna, in the role of Dharau.Neelakanti Patekar and Nana Patekar: married but living apartNana and Neelakanti never divorced, but over time they chose to live apart. In an earlier interview reported by Indian Express, Nana reflected on their relationship, saying, "Nilkanti and I shared numerous years of happiness together. We supported each other through thick and thin. But, over the years, we developed certain irreconcilable differences and grew apart. Today, we continue to be married but stay separately."Neelakanti Patekar and the loss of their first sonThe couple's journey included a deep personal grief, the death of their first son. Malhar, born later, grew to be a cherished part of their family.Nana Patekar's recent film workMeanwhile, Nana stayed busy in cinema through the later part of his career. He was part of the ‘Housefull 5’ cast alongside Akshay Kumar, Abhishek Bachchan and Riteish Deshmukh. He also took on the role of a police officer in Vishal Bhardwaj's ‘O'Romeo’, which stars Shahid Kapoor and Triptii Dimri, and made a cameo in ‘Subedar’, with Anil Kapoor and Radhikka Madan in the lead.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Nana Patekar's mortal remains sent for postmortem doctor confirms; reveals details of actor's final moments before death - WATCH
articles.summary: Veteran actor Nana Patekar, one of the country's most notable stars, passed away at his Goa residence in the early hours of Thursday morning, at age 75.
articles.body: Veteran actor Nana Patekar, one of the country's most notable stars, passed away at his Goa residence in the early hours of Thursday morning, at age 75.An official confirmation from the Manipal Hospital, Goa, stated that the actor was found unconscious at his Dona Paula, residence and was rushed to the hospital.In a video statement to the media, Dr Shekhar Salkar shared the details about the actor's final moments. Recalling the events of the night, Dr Salkar shared, "Nana Patekar was brought dead to the hospital, somewhere around 4.30 am and was declared dead by 5.30 am. We had tried our best to save him, but he was brought dead. Cardiac massage was given for almost 45 minutes to 1 hour, but he just could not be saved."Reconstructing the timeline of events from the early hours of thursday morning, the doctor said, "Somewhere around 2.30 am, he sent a message to his friend that he was not feeling well. But as it was night, he could not see the message. He went to his house at around 4 am. At that time, he was sweating. He was slowly becoming unconscious, so they sent his caretaker because they stay near the hospital."The doctor also revealed that it was the actor's caretaker and friends who rushed him to the hospital, he shared that "His family was not there."The doctor added, "The caretaker came to the hospital, took our ambulance and went with our ER team. They started cardiac massage and shifted him to the hospital somewhere around 4.20 am or 4.30 am. We also tried here to our maximum, but he was brought dead."He also confirmed that a formal police case has been registered and confirmed, "The body has now been taken to the morgue in Goa Medical College for postmortem."In a statement to PTI, he shared that investigation into the cause of death is on. He said, "It was a cardiac arrest, but we do not know the cause. He was a known cardiac patient and was on medication, as far as we have been told."Maharashtra Cultural Affairs Minister Ashish Shelar announced that Nana Patekar would be accorded a state funeral in recognition of his immense contribution to Indian cinema. In a post on X, Ashish Shelar wrote, "Considering the unparalleled contribution of actor Nana Patekar to Marathi plays as well as Marathi and Hindi cinema, we have decided to conduct his last rites 'with full state honors'."He also spoke to the media and expressed his grief over the actor's demise. "The departure of Nana Patekar ji is a profound loss for the world of art. Emerging from the lanes of Yeola, he carved out his identity in Marathi theatre, Marathi and Hindi cinema through the strength of his talent and perseverance. On his passing, heartfelt condolences from me, from the Government of Maharashtra, and from the Department of Cultural Affairs," he said.See More: Nana Patekar passes away: PM Modi hails veteran star's contribution to Hindi and Marathi cinemaGet the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
